prompt: A photorealistic outdoor PHOTOGRAPH of a single straight vertical wooden pole standing on flat open ground on a sunny day, casting one dark shadow along the ground. Obey real shadow geometry: at that low sun angle the pole's cast shadow must be LONG -- almost exactly TWICE the height of the pole (shadow length approximately 2.0 times the pole's height), because the shadow length equals the pole height divided by the tangent of the sun's elevation. Draw the pole vertical and its long shadow stretching flat along the ground away from the sun. One real photograph, flat empty ground, sharp focus, no text, labels, arrows, or annotations.
